extDescription.message: Shows citation counts next to arXiv paper titles. Data from OpenAlex; preprint and published versions are merged.

tipHeaderMerged.message: Citations in OpenAlex: papers citing any version, each counted once

tipMerging.message: This is the count for the arXiv record only. Looking for other published versions of this paper.

tipMergeFailed.message:
Counted the arXiv record only. Looking for other published versions failed: {reason}
Reload the page to try again.

tipOpenList.message: Click to see the citing papers

tipMissing.message:
OpenAlex hasn't indexed this paper yet. New papers usually appear within a few days to two weeks.
Checked {time}. Click to check again.

tipConsent.message: To work, this extension sends the paper's arXiv ID and title to OpenAlex, and it needs your OK first. Click to see the details and enable it.

errTimeout.message: OpenAlex did not respond within {s} seconds

hintBadKey.message: The OpenAlex key in settings was rejected. {settings} to replace or remove it.

hintGetKey.message: A free OpenAlex key avoids the anonymous rate limit. {settings} to add one.

settingsHint.message: Open settings from the puzzle-piece icon in the toolbar

retryWait.message: OpenAlex search is rate-limited; retrying in {s} seconds

welcomeTitle.message: Welcome to Citation Counts for arXiv

welcomeIntro.message: When you open an arXiv abstract page, the number of times the paper has been cited appears next to its title.

welcomeDataHeading.message: Before you start: what this extension sends

welcomeData1.message: It only runs on arXiv abstract pages (arxiv.org/abs/…) and reads nothing on other sites.

welcomeData2.message: On those pages it reads the paper's arXiv ID, title and author names.

welcomeData3.message: It sends the arXiv ID and title to OpenAlex (api.openalex.org), a free and open database of scholarly works, to look up citations. Author names are only compared on your computer and are never sent.

welcomeData4.message: Like any website, OpenAlex sees your IP address. If you add an OpenAlex key in settings, the key is sent to OpenAlex with each request.

welcomeData5.message: Results are cached on your computer for 12 hours. The developer runs no server and collects, tracks or sells nothing.

welcomePrivacy.message: Full details are in the privacy policy. You can withdraw your consent at any time in settings.

welcomeAgreed.message: Enabled. Go back to arXiv to see citation counts; pages you already have open update by themselves. You can close this tab.

welcomeDeclined.message: OK, nothing will be sent. To enable it later, click “Citations · click to enable” on any arXiv abstract page.

notAffiliated.message: Not affiliated with arXiv or OpenAlex.

optConsentOn.message: Enabled since {time}. The extension sends the arXiv ID and title of the paper you are viewing to OpenAlex.

optConsentOff.message: Not enabled. The extension sends nothing until you agree.

optConsentEnable.message: See what is sent and enable

optWithdrawn.message: Consent withdrawn. Nothing will be sent, and cached results on this computer were deleted.

optLead.message: A key is optional. Without one, OpenAlex often rate-limits searches, which is usually why a badge says “not merged”. A free key gives you USD 1 of usage a day and is not affected by the anonymous limit.

optStep1.message: Sign up at openalex.org

optStep2.message: Click the activation link OpenAlex emails you

optStep3.message: Copy the key from Settings → API key and paste it below

optSavedNo.message: No key saved; using the anonymous allowance

optNote.message: Your key stays in this browser on this computer. It is sent only to api.openalex.org, in a request header, never in a URL. Before saving, the extension checks it by looking up one paper, which costs nothing.

optEmpty.message: Paste a key into the box first

optKeyOk.message: The key works{quota}. Saved; badges that failed on open arXiv pages will retry by themselves.

optQuota.message: : USD {limit} a day, USD {remaining} left today

optErr401.message: OpenAlex doesn't recognize this key (401). Check that you copied all of it, or copy it again from Settings → API key on OpenAlex

optErr403.message: OpenAlex rejected this key (403, {code}). If you just signed up, click the activation link in your email first

optErr429.message: OpenAlex is rate-limiting requests (429); try again shortly: {reason}

optErrTimeout.message: OpenAlex did not respond within 20 seconds; try again later

optCleared.message: Key removed; using the anonymous allowance again.

optFooter.message: Privacy policy · Not affiliated with arXiv or OpenAlex.
